scope: Unmodified installed full host feb4e66e. Original sample01_sw archives tested at saves2/3 first. Paired tests then use identical loose-file precedence for both layouts, with original SW archives/background/effects unchanged. Temporary loose PSBs restored afterward. No mesh, effect, animation, clocks, renderer or cache quota changes.
method: 10s warmup then at least35s sampled window; exactly12 circle inputs requested at >=1500ms intervals. This is timed input, not frame-synchronized script replay. Means are dialogue-advancing FPS, not stationary FPS. Sources are copies of original sample01 saves; user slots not overwritten.
timing_scope: Upload diagnostics are emitted only above20ms. Switch-frame observations are the first logged frame spike after a model-create entry; they include other logic/effects and are not pure model latency. Suppressed/unlogged spikes are not reconstructed. Post-warmup filtering begins at the first frame-perf boundary >= load+warmup; startup and initial restoration are excluded.
quality: Original verified BC3 blocks and model metadata identical between layout pairs; pre-swizzled padding changes PSB size. OBS shows characters/background/text and 444/222 in both layouts; no new exact animated pixel oracle.
